answer_1.quote: Automated essay scoring (AES) is a machine learning task of developing a system that scores essays written in response to a given prompt (i.e., writing instructions).
answer_1.outputs: The model generates an integer score as a string (e.g., "2") in response to a student essay.

answer_2.quote: Following the standard evaluation protocol , we use the Quadratic Weighted Kappa (QWK) to measure the agreement between human-rated scores and predicted scores.
